description: This file defines the HdcpProfile class, a plugin class for handling HDCP (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection) features within a WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, getting HDCP status, and handling HDMI events, along with private members and callback functions.

classes.name: HdcpProfile
classes.description: A plugin class for managing HDCP status and HDMI events within WPEFramework, inheriting from AbstractPlugin.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the plugin operation, performing cleanup.

methods.name: getHDCPStatusWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get HDCP status, possibly via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupportWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get support status for set-top HDCP.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus
methods.description: Returns the current HDCP status as a JsonObject.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHDCPStatusEvent
methods.description: Handles HDCP status change events on HDMI output.

methods.name: logHdcpStatus
methods.description: Logs the current HDCP status with a trigger reason.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback function for HDMI events.
